source_snapshot.test_name_items: All SSD NVMe LED Check - Access /Busy
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check if access/busy LED function works normally

1. Insert NVMe SSD into BP slot and check access/busy LED

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: 1. Check system spec define LED function

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: storcli/sas3ircu/ssacli (RAID/HBA tool) or ipmitool for BMC LED
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Unverified raw IPMI command plus lsblk device list.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: Command result and device list; operator confirms physical access/busy LED.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; recognizes operator confirmation but neither defines an I/O stimulus nor proves physical LED transitions with its raw command and inventory.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds LED specification, exact mapping, approved non-destructive workload and operator observation.
historical_reviews.round_02: No separate exact-code round-02 entry was found.
historical_reviews.second_review_handoff: No V3/V3.1 baseline record exists; source, referenced script location and V2 were reviewed.

original_test_intent: Verify by physical observation that the approved NVMe bay's access/busy LED follows the platform-defined idle and activity behavior for the mapped SSD while a safe, known I/O stimulus targets only that device.
original_method: A qualified operator inserts/maps the SSD, records the idle LED, starts the owner-approved non-destructive or disposable-target I/O stimulus, visually records LED state/transitions during activity and after quiescence, while the agent captures exact device I/O counters, command timing, health and logs.
manual_activity: The defining evidence is the emitted access/busy LED observed through idle, activity and return-to-idle states, plus physical insertion. A human must perform/attest those actions; the agent can generate an approved stimulus and correlate telemetry but cannot claim the LED observation.
required_inputs: Exact chassis/backplane/bay/SSD serial and access/busy LED mapping
Specification for LED color, blink/steady pattern, latency and idle behavior
Reviewed referenced-script content/version and exact target-bound I/O workload with data-safety scope
Qualified operator and synchronized photo/video checklist
Supported read-only controller/BMC status, device I/O counters and health/log collection
safety_requirements: Do not hot-insert unless explicitly supported and do not run I/O on an OS, mounted, in-use, protected or ambiguous device.
Use a read-only workload when it can exercise the LED; if writes are required, use only an approved disposable/empty target range.
Reject the undocumented raw IPMI command; it may control a platform-specific LED and cannot prove emitted behavior.
Stop on wrong-target I/O, media/system error, unexpected LED, hardware fault or data risk; preserve evidence and do not auto-retry.
agent_execution_scope: Validate mapping, LED specification, script/workload and immutable target identity; capture idle baseline.
After approval, run the exact safe stimulus and record timestamps, I/O counters, health and system/BMC events.
Correlate operator-attributed LED video/photos with telemetry and report Tool Result without claiming visual acceptance.
engineer_actions: Approve the mapping, LED semantics and safe I/O stimulus/data scope.
Perform/attest physical insertion and visually observe idle/activity/post-idle LED behavior.
Resolve ambiguous patterns or mismatches and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The undocumented raw command is unsafe and not evidence of access/busy transitions; `lsblk` shows identity but not I/O activity or light output. The source-linked script must be reviewed before use.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Keep manual LED observation; use the reviewed project script or an approved target-bound workload solely to create known activity, with device counters and health logs as correlation.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: SSD insertion, access/busy LED check, referenced script and 15/8-minute fields are preserved; no generic write workload is invented.

modernized_recommendation.status: SYNCHRONIZED MANUAL LED VIDEO AND TARGET I/O TELEMETRY
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record idle/activity/idle LED video with visible bay identity and timestamps while a serial-bound workload and I/O counters create and prove the intended stimulus; retain full health/log evidence.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record chassis/backplane, controller/BMC, SSD firmware, OS/kernel, script and workload-tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform LED specification and reviewed internal access_busy script must define semantics and stimulus.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds the missing controlled activity state and correlation while preserving visual acceptance.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; physical LED behavior remains primary and all project-defined states must be observed.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: LED timing/pattern spec and safe workload.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Management status and counters cannot prove the physical LED's color, location or emitted transitions.

project_override_considerations: A project may define read-only versus approved write activity and per-bay LED patterns. It must record the exact workload and may not infer LED success from command output alone.
expected_evidence: Bay/SSD/LED map, specification, reviewed script/workload and authorization
Operator-attributed synchronized LED evidence at idle, active I/O and return to idle
Exact target identity, workload transcript, per-device I/O counters and read-only status
Drive/system/BMC health/logs, any mismatch, Tool Result and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and criterion consistently defer the expected access/busy behavior to the platform specification. The absent explicit workload is a readiness/method gap, not a contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The access/busy LED purpose is clear. Specification/workload/mapping availability are readiness inputs; visual LED acceptance makes the case MANUAL ONLY.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains operator observation but rejects its undocumented raw command and incomplete activity evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains mapping, safe workload and spec gates while applying MANUAL ONLY for physical LED acceptance.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Defines idle/activity/idle phases, target-safe stimulus and synchronized evidence instead of a generic device list.

review_improvement: Makes access/busy behavior causally traceable to the intended SSD without risking unrelated data or substituting management output for light observation.
independent_technical_reasoning: The activity stimulus and telemetry can be automated, but the core criterion is a human-observed physical LED transition. Under the locked rule, the complete case is MANUAL ONLY rather than PARTIAL.

no_automatic_retry: Do not repeat an abnormal LED/workload sequence automatically. Stop the stimulus, preserve evidence and await owner direction.
